description: Golden verify-tasks: canonical constraints the harness encodes, checked mechanically against the repo. Each task = a doctrine rule + the check that proves it still holds. Failing tasks mean the doctrine and the repo have drifted apart — which is itself a finding worth surfacing.

tasks.doctrine: AGENTS.md first-commands: `node bin/ai.cjs hooks` activates the tracked git hooks so the learning loop fires.
AI_PLAYBOOK §5: learnings are recorded through the CLI (`node bin/ai.cjs memory ...`), never by hand-editing .mycelium/memory.json.
AGENT-CONTEXT.md §4 owns the mobile CSS rules: viewport lock and triple-layer overflow protection.
Two brands never cross-contaminate: NW ember #ff6b00 and KINTSUGI gold #c9a84c each appear in their own doctrine tables.
AGENTS.md map: shipping goes through `node bin/mycelium.cjs ship "msg"`.
The harness's claimed token savings are backed by a committed, regenerable receipt: evals/results/context-cost.json.
ARCHITECTURE.md is the definitive LIVE/GENERATED/LEGACY status map and AGENTS.md routes disoriented agents to it.
No orphaned scripts or frozen audits live at the repo root — fossils are quarantined under legacy/ with a self-explaining README.
Every archived script carries a LEGACY banner at the top so even a direct read cannot be mistaken for live code.
tools/ai-tell-lint.cjs exempts moved docs at their new paths (docs/PRODUCTION-PIPELINE.md, legacy/audits/*) — stale paths mean silent lint drift.

The deep system reference is docs/SYSTEM-ARCHITECTURE.md. Root ARCHITECTURE.md is the LIVE/GENERATED/LEGACY status map. The two never share a name — a collision would disorient agents about which doc answers which question.
No live doc links to the old root AUDIT-2026-04.md path — fossils moved to legacy/audits/ and every pointer followed them.
ARCHITECTURE.md records the retired PM2 workflow as fossilized — the live dev server is `npm run dev` (Vite, 5173), never `pm2 start`.
The harness's output-side proof (does memory actually help a live model) exists as evals/outcome-eval.cjs and is positioned in docs/POSITIONING.md.

The outcome proof is a trend, not a snapshot: evals/outcome-eval.cjs appends every --write run to evals/results/outcome-history.jsonl, and tools/harness-report.cjs reads that history into outcomeTrend so the dashboard shows the series.
Real breakages become eval tasks: tools/add-failure-task.cjs appends to evals/tasks/failures.json and evals/outcome-eval.cjs loads them into the corpus (failure-authored).

The anti-slop linters are graded, not trusted: evals/linter-eval.cjs runs the three linter layers (text/layout/code) against hand-authored golden fixtures (evals/linter-fixtures/manifest.json) with known correct verdicts — planted slop must fire (recall), clean and adversarial content must not (precision). Run with npm run eval:linter.

Slop is prevented upstream, not only detected downstream: tools/style-contract.json is the single source of truth for what NumbahWan work looks like, and tools/generation-contract.cjs injects it into generation calls (prompt block + self-critique checklist + exemplar anchor per medium). The linters are the backstop, not the primary defense.

Exemplar anchoring beats prohibition: every medium has at least one golden exemplar (evals/style-exemplars/) that generation calls imitate few-shot. Each exemplar passes its medium's linter clean (gold standard, re-verified by the pre-commit gate on every edit).
